modules.description: Program leadership, quality assurance, phased releases, and organizational adoption.

reasoning: The brief spans patient experiences, a new enterprise agenda, telemedicine, multiple clinical/financial integrations, and strict GDPR and regional ePrescription requirements. I separated modules by domain boundaries and external dependencies (scheduling, video, billing, eRx/labs) to isolate risk and enable parallel work. Compliance, IAM, and offline home nursing are distinct due to data sensitivity and security-by-design needs. Notifications and analytics were split to meet operational needs (reminders, KPI visibility). Data migration is embedded within scheduling where the source system change occurs. Accessibility and multilingual support are treated as first-class tasks in the patient app. The plan acknowledges the September milestone by centering delivery/QA/change management on a phased rollout with the agenda and portal first, followed by integrations and advanced features.
